messages:
Devin (Acme): Hey team — procurement says they cannot generate a PO without a pro-forma that lists VAT and references our contract. We're blocked from closing month-end. Invoice: INV-2026-0813. Can you help today?

Sara - Support: Sorry you're blocked, Devin. I'll triage with billing. Are they asking for a PO number up front or just the pro-forma to create the PO? :thinking_face: 

billing-bot: Account lookup: account_id=acct_7G4Y, tier=Enterprise, contract_ref=MSA-2024-07, billing_policy=po_required_for_invoice

Tom - Billing: Hi Devin — for Enterprise customers with a signed MSA our standard process is to have a PO before issuing a final invoice (it's in the contract). We can issue a pro-forma / statement of charges immediately so procurement can raise ACME-PO-7721. Will that unblock you?

Devin (Acme): Yes, a pro-forma works. Procurement also insists the SOW number appears on the pro-forma (SOW-11) and that our VAT ID is present. They typically create a PO entry from the pro-forma.

Maria - Legal: Quick checklist for the pro-forma to be acceptable to procurement:
- Reference: MSA-2024-07 and SOW-11
- Mark clearly: "Pro-forma invoice - not a tax invoice"
- Include Acme billing address + remit-to
- Include VAT/Tax ID: VAT-EU-334455
- Itemized services + billing period
- Total and subtotal lines
If the PO alters payment terms or remit address, procurement needs to call that out explicitly.

Tom - Billing: Understood. I'll generate PF-2026-0813 (pro-forma) and email it to Devin plus billing@procurement.acme.example in ~30-60m. I'll include line items and the SOW reference. Draft snippet below for visibility:

```
Pro-forma PF-2026-0813
Reference: MSA-2024-07 / SOW-11
Customer: Acme Inc. (acct_7G4Y)
VAT ID: VAT-EU-334455
Items:
  - Dedicated capacity reservation - Feb 2026 - Qty 1 - $18,000.00
  - Overage (tokens) - Jan 2026 - $450.00
Subtotal: $18,450.00
VAT: 0% (reverse charge) or specify if applicable
Total: $18,450.00
Note: Pro-forma invoice - not a tax invoice. Subject to conversion to invoice upon receipt of PO ACME-PO-7721.
```

Sara - Support: I'll stay on the thread to confirm when the PO PDF lands. Devin, procurement can email the PO to billing@redwood.com once the pro-forma exists — that will let us convert it to an official invoice. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: Action created: ticket #BILL-3129 assigned to Tom - Billing. SLA: 24h.

Devin (Acme): Great, thanks all. I'll push procurement for a same-day turnaround and will upload the PO PDF as soon as it's approved. Appreciate the quick help.

Tom - Billing: No problem — will post the emailed pro-forma here when sent."
